title: SAFECode FPSSD 3rd ed. — records the practices call for (DERIVED)
description: DERIVED by this library from SAFECode prose; SAFECode publishes no schema. Field descriptions quote the source.

Severity.description: 'implementing a severity scale (e.g., Critical, High, Medium and Low or a finer grained scale, Very High, High, Medium, Low, Very Low, Informational)' — the scale is the organization's choice; both examples given

is_security_issue.description: 'they should also be identified as security issues'

status.description: 'action taken to remediate, mitigate or accept the respective risk'

tracking_system.description: 'recorded in a tracking (ideally an ADLM) system'

technique.description: TSRV T: 'the type of mitigation in effect using MITRE’s Monster Mitigations'

specifics.description: TSRV S: 'the specific compensating control in effect'

remaining_risk.description: TSRV R: 'the risk that the mitigation does not address'

verification.description: TSRV V: 'how the mitigation’s effectiveness was verified'

remediation_plan_or_expiry.description: 'a remediation plan or expiration or re-review period for the exception'

approver.description: 'appropriately empowered individuals ... This should vary by the residual risk; e.g., Critical Risk to VP of Business Unit, Medium Risk to Engineering Manager'

SecurityAdvisory.description: 'Security Advisories and Bulletins will typically include the following information where applicable'

affected.description: Products, applicable versions and platforms affected

description.description: Brief description of the vulnerability and potential impact if exploited

ApplicationSecurityControl.description: 'Each security requirement identified should be tracked through implementation and verification ... manage the controls as structured data in an Application Development Lifecycle Management (ADLM) system'

status.description: INFERRED from the five-step workflow under Actively Manage Application Security Controls
